mode: real code + read-only model cache; all network inference refused; no fake outputs
scoring: Dataset numeric gold only: engine.bench.score exact rounded counts, measurements within max(0.05, 2%). Abstentions are failures; missing cards are reported outside buckets.
loader_note: Percent must be correct/n only. These audit-fitted buckets are candidates, not independently validated production probabilities. No match means no percent; do not add heuristic bonuses. Missing checked means no measured check verdict.

proposed_confidence_constants.exact_proposed_edit: Change base literal 97 to 100 in the 'ifc' source branch, only after independent validation; remove heuristic bonuses before treating the result as a probability.
proposed_confidence_constants.qualification: Descriptive estimate from this audit, not independent validation. Refit on a disjoint, live-model calibration set before shipping.

other_constants.printed_text_base_93: Do not change from unjudged text gold; verify source exactness separately.
other_constants.vector_pdf_base_88: Out of scope: no PDF observations.
other_constants.vision_reader_base_65: No live-reader validation; do not infer a production probability from unavailable-provider fallbacks.
other_constants.agreement_bonus_8_or_5: Agreement is not independence. Do not calibrate the bonus without separately labeled agreement/disagreement cohorts.
other_constants.detector_bonus_minus6_to_plus3: Object detector confidence is not exact count probability; per-kind held-back calibration needed.
other_constants.exact_source_floor_92: Remove or gate on a supported operation: exact source data alone does not prove the chosen scope, aggregation, or bbox measurement is correct.

limitations: Not a representative production distribution: stratified by source/type with repeated documents.
Wilson intervals assume independent Bernoulli observations; repeated documents violate that assumption, so intervals may be too narrow.
Gold may contain annotation errors. No manual gold correction was made to improve accuracy.
Same audit supplies candidate constants and error estimates; candidates require independent validation.
Cached model outputs and unavailable-provider fallbacks differ from a fully live run.
No training or thresholds were changed based on held-back files.
